scientific_integrity: The universal results follow from analytic inequalities and Gaussian integrals; a standalone numerical checker exercises finite recurrences and quadratures without being a proof of limiting claims. scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; once-sampled independent Gaussian operator and independent finite-second-moment right-hand noise; single one-row/one-unknown Fourier mode; no claim for arbitrary tensor dimensions, adaptive stopping, fresh operator draws, or noise correlations. title: Gaussian operator noise forces dimension-dependent risk growth in damped scalar Kaczmarz
